svg.title: Finding the files of a page of documents
svg.desc: Paperless answers with documents 412, 389 and 371. One search of the file cache looks in the folders of the searching user for the names that carry any of their markers. Of the files it finds, only a file of the archive account with the exact marker of a document stands for it, and of several such files the one with the first path. Documents 412 and 371 get their file; document 389 has none and is left out.
